summary: Recent updates to the Firefox browser's media handling capabilities focus on enhancing protected playback using Microsoft's Media Foundation Content Decryption Module (MFCDM). The improvements introduce hardware support for decoding protected content, which can lead to **better performance and higher quality when watching DRM-protected videos**, such as movies on streaming services. Several patches work on ensuring that the browser accurately tracks when the system is ready to play protected content, automatically handling errors and improving overall reliability. These changes are crucial as they support industry standards for secure media playback, allowing users to enjoy seamless and high-quality video experiences without interruptions.
